column5: This is a draft for horizontal orientation
For vertical orientation use vertical csv draft
Sample Map pattern can be changed.
* up to 12 positions possible in one row
* need to be consecutive, no gaps
* not possible to define more Contents/Sample IDs as in the previous row
Content field needs to be defined with B, C or S
Blank, Control and Sample content cannot be combined in one row.
If Position and Content is defined and no Sample ID, Sample IDs are named automatically:
Duplicate names can be loaded and will automatically be numbered as duplicate (example: Sample XYZ, Sample XYZ(1))
